name: Evercurrent
description: Allows for sending data about required updates to the Evercurrent server
project_description: Evercurrent connects a Drupal site to the Evercurrent service at https://app.evercurrent.io so available core, module, theme and installation-profile updates are reported to a central dashboard. On each qualifying cron run the module gathers Drupal's Update Manager data plus the list of enabled modules and themes and POSTs it, together with the site's API key and base URL, to the Evercurrent server. From the dashboard you can review pending updates across many sites in one place and receive email reports (for example when a security release becomes available). The API key that identifies the site to the server can be stored in module configuration or, for multi-environment setups, in settings.php so that only production reports. The module adds status entries to the Drupal status report page and supports an optional listening mode in which the server can push the API key to the site.
